title: Design and synthesis of novel sulfa-azo dyes: a sustainable approach to textile dyeing combined with microwave energy
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5374-5400
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09499B, Paper

New sulfonamide-based azo dyes with antimicrobial qualities were synthesized and dyed on fabric using microwave irradiation, an energy-efficient substitute for traditional heating techniques.
